questions.question: Which of the following provisions of the Indian Constitution applies to the Panchayats and Municipalities in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Seventh Schedule (Part IXA and IXB) applies to the Panchayats and Municipalities in West Bengal.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the Governor of West Bengal as per the Indian Constitution?
options: To act as the head of the state
To safeguard the interests of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
To nominate members to the Legislative Council
questions.correctIndex: To safeguard the interests of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
questions.explanation: The Governor of West Bengal has to safeguard the interests of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

questions.question: Which of the following is a fundamental duty of a citizen of India, as enshrined in the Indian Constitution?
options: To respect the Constitution and the national flag
To promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst all the people of India
To uphold the dignity of the Constitution
questions.explanation: A citizen of India is expected to promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst all the people of India.

questions.question: What is the name of the provision in the West Bengal Panchayat Act, 1973, which enables the State Government to supersede a Panchayat Samiti?
questions.explanation: The West Bengal Panchayat Act, 1973, has Section 84, which enables the State Government to supersede a Panchayat Samiti.

questions.question: Which of the following is a feature of the West Bengal Legislative Council?
questions.explanation: West Bengal has a unicameral legislature with 295 members.

questions.explanation: The Regulating Act of 1773 led to the Indian Rebellion of 1857.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the 'Swasthya Bhita' scheme launched by the West Bengal government?
options: To improve maternal and child healthcare services
To increase the availability of medical doctors in rural areas
To provide financial assistance to families affected by poverty
To promote health insurance for all citizens
questions.explanation: It aims to enhance maternal and child healthcare services in rural West Bengal.

questions.question: The 'Duare Duare' scheme is primarily focused on which of the following services?
options: Issuance of ration cards and Aadhaar cards
Distribution of free food grains and essential commodities
Provision of health insurance and medical services
questions.explanation: It aims to simplify the process of issuing ration cards and Aadhaar cards for residents of West Bengal.

questions.question: What is the main goal of the 'Kanyashree Prakalpa' scheme launched by the West Bengal government?
options: To provide vocational training to teenage girls
To encourage girls to pursue higher education
To prevent child marriages and promote girls' empowerment
To provide financial assistance to families with female children
questions.explanation: It aims to prevent child marriages and promote girls' empowerment through financial incentives.

questions.question: The 'Mamata Banerjee Swasthya Seva Yojana' focuses on which of the following aspects of healthcare?
options: Improving healthcare infrastructure in rural areas
Increasing the availability of medical specialists in government hospitals
Providing free healthcare services to the poor and marginalized
Enhancing medical education and research in West Bengal
questions.explanation: It aims to provide free healthcare services to the poor and marginalized residents of West Bengal.

questions.question: The 'Mukhyamantri Gramin Internship Yojana' is primarily aimed at providing internships to students in which sector?
questions.explanation: It aims to provide internships to students in the agriculture sector and enhance rural development.

questions.question: A pipe can fill 1/4th of a tank in 2 hours. How many hours will it take to fill the whole tank?
questions.explanation: Time taken is the reciprocal of the fraction filled per hour.

questions.question: A man can do a piece of work in 4 days. If he works 2 hours less each day, how many days will he take to complete the work?
questions.explanation: Reduced working hours per day will increase the total number of days required.

questions.question: A water tank can be filled by a pipe in 6 hours. If a drain can empty the tank in 12 hours, how many hours will it take to fill the tank when pipe and drain are working simultaneously?
questions.explanation: Combined rate of filling and emptying will give the net time required.

questions.question: A worker can load 1/5th of a wagon in 2 hours. If he works for 5 hours, what fraction of the wagon will he load?
questions.explanation: Fraction of the wagon loaded will be the product of the fraction loaded per hour and the total hours worked.

questions.question: A man and a boy can mow a field in 3 hours and 6 hours respectively. Working together, how many hours will they take to mow the field?
questions.explanation: Combined rate of mowing will give the net time required.

questions.question: A train travels from Kolkata to Sealdah, a distance of 10 km in 10 minutes. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.explanation: Speed is calculated as distance divided by time.

questions.question: A person travels from Howrah to Kolkata in 2 hours and 30 minutes. If the speed of the person is 20 km/h, in how much time will he cover the same distance at a speed of 25 km/h?
questions.explanation: Time is inversely proportional to speed.

questions.question: A car travels from Siliguri to Jalpaiguri, a distance of 50 km in 1 hour and 15 minutes. What is the average speed of the car in km/h?
questions.explanation: Average speed is total distance divided by total time.

questions.question: A cyclist travels from Durgapur to Asansol at an average speed of 15 km/h and covers a distance of 30 km in 2 hours. What is the total distance covered by the cyclist in the next 4 hours?
questions.explanation: Distance is equal to speed multiplied by time.

questions.question: A bus travels from Malda to Balurghat, a distance of 80 km in 2 hours. What is the average speed of the bus in km/h?
questions.explanation: Average speed is total distance divided by total time.
